content: {"like":["Campy, snipey dialogue and barbed banter between Bette and Joan","Cheesy, horroresque camera angles and cuts that heighten tension","The steel‑corded tension and mutual dislike/respect that keeps viewers on edge","Stellar performances by Jessica Lange and Susan Sarandon","Awesome supporting cast including Jackie Hoffman, Judy Davis, Stanley Tucci, Alfred Molina, Alison Wright","Fun recurring cameos by Catherine Zeta‑Jones and Kathy Bates","The show’s guilty‑pleasure vibe and juicy exploration of the feud","The tragic, poignant look at aging women’s struggles in Hollywood"],"dislike":["The series loses its campy flavor as it progresses","It becomes a rather tragic tale of loneliness, aging, mortality, rejection and hollowness of fame","The portrayal of the actresses’ loneliness and lack of acceptance feels heavy and sad","The show’s focus on the actresses’ bitterness and desperation can feel over‑dramatic"]}
